generator.title: Single Box Generator
generator.subtitle: With intuitive sliders for width, depth, and drawer height.
generator.heightHint: Choose a drawer height; the actual box height is mapped accordingly.
generator.plateHint: Based on the selected suitcase variant (file: {file}).
generator.hint: Bottom pickups and grid pitch are invariant.

planner.title: Layout Planner
planner.description: Drag a rectangle over the grid plate to create a box. Valid areas are shown in green, invalid areas in red.
planner.heightScopeSelection: Applied to {count, plural, one {the selected box} other {# selected boxes}}.
planner.keyboardHint: Tip: Arrow keys move the selection · Del removes · Esc clears the selection.

autofill.title: Auto-fill
autofill.smallRemainderWarning: {regions} small remainder region(s) totaling {cells} cells — often unsuitable for print.

persistence.title: Save & share
persistence.importInvalid: File could not be read as a layout.
persistence.shareLoadFailed: Shared layout could not be loaded ({code}).

warnings.DRAFT_UNKNOWN_KIND: File has no SlotCrate marker — loaded best-effort.
warnings.DRAFT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: Different schema version — some details may be missing.
warnings.DRAFT_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH: Different geometry version — result may differ.
warnings.DRAFT_VARIANT_UNKNOWN: Unknown suitcase variant — keeping active variant.

dividers.title: Internal dividers
dividers.hint: Thickness {thickness} mm (= wall thickness). Positions are measured from the inner cavity origin.
dividers.dragHint: Tip: hold Alt + left-click on a divider in the 3D view and drag to move it directly.

pockets.title: Round pockets
pockets.tooManyWarning: Square grid would produce {count} pockets — exceeds limit ({max}). Choose a larger diameter.
pockets.hint: Wall thickness {thickness} mm (= box wall thickness). The diameter is the inner diameter (usable space) — the outer diameter equals inner diameter + 2× wall thickness. The cup sits on the cavity floor; height = cup wall height.
pockets.fillOuter: Fill outer area with solid material
pockets.fillOuterHintOff: Frame mode (default): each pocket is a standalone cup.
pockets.fillOuterHintOn: Fill mode: the cavity is filled up to the tallest pocket height and pockets are drilled into that slab as wells.
pockets.dragHint: Tip: hold Alt + left-click on a pocket in the 3D view and drag to move it directly.

waveInserts.title: Wave inserts
waveInserts.empty: No wave inserts — cavity is open.
waveInserts.hint: Wave-shaped grooves for round tools (e.g. screwdrivers), which then rest in a curved arc. Groove depth controls how hard or soft the arc is (max. = half the groove diameter).
waveInserts.mismatchMessage: The new groove diameter no longer matches the current groove count and would leave a gap on the side. Adjust the count to {count} so the cavity is filled without a gap again?

editor.noSelectionHint: Click a cutout on the shelf plan or list to adjust its size and position.
editor.emptyLevel: No cutouts on this level. Click '+ Add Cutout' or choose a quick preset.

wizard.title: Auto 2-Tier Placement Wizard
wizard.subtitle: Enter your desired bottle and vial diameters. The wizard calculates the optimal layout automatically across Level 1 (up to 42 mm) and Level 2 (up to 36.2 mm).
wizard.noItemsHint: No bottles added yet. Click '+ Add size'.

wizard.fitsAllSuccess: All {count} bottles fit perfectly across both shelf levels!
wizard.overflowWarning: Not enough space ({unplaced} {unplaced, plural, one {bottle does} other {bottles do}} not fit)
wizard.overflowDetail: Only {placed} of {total} bottles could be placed.
